title: DCP Even-Sublattice Parity Blindness and Mod-2^{t-1} Rescaling Bridge
claims: For any v in ker(A mod 2) and any x_0 in {0,1}^K, tilde_A(v, x_0) lies in the even sublattice (2 Z_{2^t})^n.

Any target shift h with an odd coordinate has strictly zero compressed collisions on ker(A mod 2), while for t >= 2 halving maps tilde_A_j(x_0)/2 -> B_j(x_0) in Z_{2^{t-1}}^n and h -> h' = (2^{t-2}, 0, ..., 0).

Conditioned on any fixed (A mod 2, disjoint non-empty V_1..V_m, x_0), uniform upper bits A^{(high)} = floor(A/2) induce exact IID uniform halved columns B_1(x_0), ..., B_m(x_0) over Z_{2^{t-1}}^n of size Q_even = 2^{n(t-1)}.
